name: local-directory-extractor
title: Local Directory Extractor
description: Extract business listings from local directories and yellow-page style sites: names, categories, addresses, phones and websites - the dataset feeds directly into outreach tooling.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Local Directory Extractor
input.description: Extract business listings from local directories and yellow-page style sites: names, categories, addresses, phones and websites - the dataset feeds directly into outreach tooling.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on processed pages (runaway protection).

category_filter.title: Category filter
category_filter.description: Only keep listings matching this category keyword.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
